description: This file defines the structure and functions for managing array stacks in Adobe's code, including initialization, finalization, setting count, clearing, and pushing elements.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_init
methods.description: Initializes an array stack with specified item size, memory, and error pointer.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the array stack.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_setCount
methods.description: Sets the number of elements in the array stack.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the array stack.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_getBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer of the array stack.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_getPointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at the specified index.

methods.name: cf2_arrstack_push
methods.description: Pushes a new element onto the array stack.
